cards.name: Ohmen Beacon

effects.printed_clause: On activation, optionally Special Summon a Thunder from hand, or if controlling an "Ohmechanic", an "Ohmen" from GY instead; only 1 activation per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: Free-chain activation with oath count optionally selects either branch. Hand candidates check summon legality; the GY filter checks only Ohmen/Necrovalley before calling SpecialSummon.

official_references.matched_structure: Continuous Spell activation with optional branch-based Special Summon.

effects.printed_clause: GY branch: Special Summon an "Ohmen" monster from your GY.
effects.lua_implementation: The GY branch uses an Ohmen filter that requires Necrovalley legality and IsCanBeSpecialSummoned before the option is offered and again when the monster is selected.

official_references.matched_structure: Official GY Special Summon filter includes IsCanBeSpecialSummoned and Necrovalley legality.

effects.printed_clause: Co-linked monsters you control with a Current Counter cannot be targeted by opponent card effects.
effects.lua_implementation: Field EFFECT_CANNOT_BE_EFFECT_TARGET uses mutual-link count plus counter count and aux.tgoval.

effects.printed_clause: Once per turn, move 1 monster you control to another Main Monster Zone, then place a Current Counter on all your co-linked monsters.
effects.lua_implementation: The ignition target requires both a free Main Monster Zone and a selectable face-up controlled monster, then moves that monster and counters all currently co-linked controlled monsters.

official_references.matched_structure: Official movement operation first verifies a movable monster and destination.

cards.audit_note: Rejected both reported defects. The GY filter already checks IsCanBeSpecialSummoned, and the movement target already requires both a free zone and a selectable controlled face-up monster.

coverage_override.reason: All printed procedures, continuous clauses, activated/triggered effects, branches, and attached once-per-turn restrictions are represented in the listed semantic effect records.
